dataset: EPA National Rivers and Streams Assessment 2018-19 (NRSA 2018-19)
source_statement: Pulled in December 2025 from the EPA published records for the NRSA 2018-19 dataset (owner statement, recorded 2026-08-21). The specific archive file names were not recorded at download time.
conversion: Converted from the prior R application data (.rds) by scripts/convert_data.py. The parquet and CSVs in this folder are the converted artifacts, not the EPA originals.
